claim: PTFE Sprayed On Blue Masks Causes Symptoms Similar To COVID-19
justification: High-confidence evidence establishes that PTFE is not sprayed on blue surgical masks, which are made from polypropylene, and that PTFE toxicity requires high temperatures not present in normal mask use. Additionally, there is no credible evidence linking PTFE on masks to COVID-19-like symptoms, with low-confidence claims to the contrary being contradicted by authoritative sources.
